app.name: TARANAKA
app.logoAlt: Taranaka logo: a pregnant mother and her children. Women, pregnancy, child health, nutrition.

user.idleLogout: You were signed out after {minutes} minutes of inactivity.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: For staff of CSB, CRENAS and CRENI centres, and supervisors.
login.identifierHelp: Your phone number or the username given by your supervisor.
login.totpIntro: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code shown for TARANAKA.
login.enrollIntro: Two-factor authentication is required to protect patient records. Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (for example FreeOTP, Aegis or Google Authenticator), then enter the code it shows.
login.enrollQrAlt: QR code to set up the authenticator app
login.enrollManual: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app:

errors.locked: Account locked. Try again in {minutes} minute(s).
errors.lockedAdmin: Account locked. Contact an administrator to unlock it.
errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Wait a minute before trying again.
errors.totpInvalid: Wrong or expired code. Enter the new code shown.
errors.totpFormat: The code must be exactly 6 digits.
errors.noWebAccess: Your profile has no access to this dashboard. Community health workers use the mobile app.

access.title: Access denied
access.body: Your profile has no access to this dashboard. Community health workers use the mobile app.
access.forbidden: You are not allowed to open this page.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This address does not match any page of the dashboard.

errors.network: The server is not responding. Check the connection and try again.
errors.session_expired: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.unauthorized: Your session has expired. Sign in again.
errors.forbidden: Your profile does not allow this action.
errors.not_found: This item does not exist or is not visible to your centre.
errors.conflict: This record was changed in the meantime. The latest version is shown: check it, then try again.
errors.validation: Some information is invalid. Correct it, then try again.
errors.throttled: Too many requests. Wait a minute.
errors.server: The server ran into an error. Try again later.

queue.title: Incoming referrals
queue.intro: Sorted by urgency (red, orange, yellow), then oldest first.
queue.emptyHint: New referrals appear here as soon as the community health worker syncs their phone.

search.label: Search by referral code
search.title: Search by code
search.notFound: No referral with code {code} for your centre.
search.hint: The code is on the slip the family brings. Check each character with them.

referral.title: Referral {code}
referral.disclaimer: TARANAKA guides referrals; it does not diagnose. Care and discharge decisions remain the professional's responsibility.

confirm.recu: Confirm that patient {code} arrived? The community health worker will see “Received by the centre” at their next sync.

referral.dischargeOnlyAgent: Only a nurse or doctor at the destination centre can record the discharge.
referral.late: Not arrived within the expected time

care.title: Care and follow-up
care.dateInPast: The follow-up date must be today or later.
care.dateInFuture: The date cannot be in the future.

discharge.title: Record discharge
discharge.intro: Only a professional at the destination centre can record a discharge. This closes the record and cannot be undone.
discharge.confirm: Close record {code} with outcome “{outcome}”? This cannot be undone.

child.title: Child record
child.name: Name
child.noReferrals: No referrals visible to your centre.

measurements.title: Measurement history
measurements.zscoreSource: WHO 2006 z-scores computed by the server.

charts.summaryEmpty: {title}: not enough measurements to draw a curve.
charts.whoNote: Reference curves: WHO 2006 child growth standards (−3, −2, median, +2, +3 z), computed by the server from the official tables.
charts.whoMissing: The WHO tables are not loaded on the server: only the child's measurements and the SAM / MAM thresholds are drawn.

conflicts.title: Sync conflicts
conflicts.intro: Two devices changed the same clinical record. Nothing is overwritten automatically: choose, field by field, which value to keep.
conflicts.count: No conflicts | 1 conflict to resolve | {n} conflicts to resolve
conflicts.differentFields: No differing fields | 1 differing field | {n} differing fields
conflicts.confirm: Confirm this choice? The other values are kept in the history.
conflicts.commentHelp: Explain your choice (for example: checked with the mother).

stats.title: Aggregate statistics
stats.intro: Anonymous data. Any figure covering fewer than 5 cases is hidden.
stats.invalidRange: The start date must be before the end date.
stats.noData: No data for this period and area.
stats.zoneLocked: Your account is limited to this region.
stats.exportHint: The file holds the same figures as the by-region view, with “<5” for hidden figures. Each export is recorded in the audit log.
stats.hiddenNote: “< 5”: figure hidden to protect anonymity (fewer than 5 cases, or deducible from the other figures).

charts.outcomesIntro: How the treatments of the period ended.

cases.title: Are acute malnutrition cases going up?
cases.summaryShort: SAM and MAM children found, month by month ({n} months).

arrival.title: Do referred children reach the centre?
arrival.introRegion: Referrals that arrived out of all referrals, by region. The furthest behind first.
arrival.introMonth: Referrals that arrived out of all referrals, by month. The furthest behind first.

offline.banner: No connection. The data shown may be out of date; actions will resume when the network is back.

accessRequest.title: Request access
accessRequest.intro: For nurses and doctors of CSBs, CRENAS, CRENI and CRENAM, and for supervisors. An administrator checks each request before opening the account.
accessRequest.agentsNote: Community health worker? Your supervisor creates your account: please ask them.

profileHints.agent_csb: Receives the referrals of their centre and updates the records.
profileHints.superviseur: Sees anonymous statistics and manages the community health workers of their region.

hints.nationalRegion: Leave “National” if you follow the whole country or a programme.
hints.phone: The administrator will call you to check your request.
hints.identifiant: What you will type to sign in, for example firstname.centre.
hints.message: For example your department or the name of your manager.

accessRequest.afterSubmit: Your account stays closed until it is approved. Then, at your first sign-in, you will turn on two-factor authentication.
accessRequest.sentBody: An administrator will check your request. They may call you on the number you gave.
accessRequest.sentNext: Once the request is approved, sign in with the identifier and PIN you chose.

errors.pin: The PIN must have 4 to 6 digits.
errors.pinMismatch: The two PINs do not match.
errors.throttled: Too many requests from this connection. Try again in an hour.

accessRequests.title: Access requests
accessRequests.intro: Check who the person is (for example by calling their centre) before approving: the profile and centre decide which records they will see.
accessRequests.reasonHint: For the record: the person does not receive a message.
accessRequests.checkFirst: The account will open with this profile and centre. Correct them if the request is wrong.

agents.title: My community health workers
agents.intro: Create the accounts of the workers in your region and reset a forgotten PIN. You only see who they are, never health records.
agents.createTitle: Create a community health worker account
agents.createIntro: The worker will use this identifier and PIN in the mobile app, in agent mode.
agents.identifiantHint: For example their phone number or firstname.village. It must be unique.
agents.resetIntro: The account is unblocked and its sessions are closed. The worker signs in again with this PIN; their synced data comes back at sign-in.

handover.note: Give this to the worker in person. The PIN will not be shown again.

agents.emptyHint: Create the first account with “New worker”.
agents.name: Name
